title: The consequences of sin
intro: Allah knows what helps us and what harms us – that is why sin is forbidden.

learn.html: Allah created people and knows best their nature, soul and body. Allah knows what helps people and what harms them – so people are forbidden to sin.

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “A person sometimes says a word without thinking whether it is good or not, and because of it he is thrown into the Fire.” (Bukhari)
A sinner will feel the greatest consequences of sin on the Day of Judgement, but many are seen already in this world. They harm the person, the family and society.

items: harm to mental and physical health

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) warned: “When immorality appears among a people and is done openly, plagues and diseases come that earlier peoples did not know.” (Ibn Majah)

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: The goal of life is happiness in this world and the next. To reach it, every Muslim must keep away from sin.
